'''Geonosian Serum''' was a substance made by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tramulek]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] that when injected would potentially pacify [[Darth Malora]]'s modified [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]]. It was however not a cure that could reverse the effects.<ref name="scienceodark" />
